title: Cold forge or slow fallback
query: Create a helper that extracts sorted query parameter names from a URL like https://example.com/path?a=1&b=2
expected_focus: Show first-time slow path behavior, forge/fallback latency, and traceable failure if no LLM key is configured.

title: Warm reuse paraphrase
query: Return sorted query keys for URL https://example.com/path?a=1&b=2
expected_focus: Show fast path reuse, accepted retrieval decision, low total latency, and reused_existing_tool=true.

title: Registry-only miss
query: Summarize this free-form paragraph into three teaching bullets without using numeric or table data.
expected_focus: Show registry-only rejection or miss behavior and explain why fallback is disabled for this strategy.

title: Fallback success
expected_focus: Show deterministic slow fallback success and compare its latency against warm reuse.

title: MCP-compatible direct invocation
query: Use the Tool Browser to inspect a registered tool schema, then invoke the matching tool with a concrete payload.
expected_focus: Show catalog/schema visibility and direct invocation path. Backend/MCP owners can replace this with external MCP client output.
